logging_fileline.description: Enable logging of source file and line number (ignored by vqsim)

logging_to_stderr.description: Send log output to standard error (ignored by vqsim)

logging_to_logfile.description: Send log output to a log file (ignored by vqsim, but required to set logfile)

logging_logfile.description: Path to log file if logging_to_logfile is true (ignored by vqsim)

logging_timestamp.description: Prefix log lines with timestamp (ignored by vqsim)

nodes.description: List of nodes for vqsim to simulate. Each node must have nodeid. Only nodeid and votes affect behavior; IP fields are ignored by vqsim.
